cards.text: Twenty YEARS, friend. That's how long Solomon, king of Israel, spent building two houses: the house of the LORD and his royal palace. Now he has something for Hiram king of Tyre, the man who supplied him with cedar and cypress logs and gold for his every desire.

cards.question: Solomon gives Hiram king of Tyre twenty ___ in the land of Galilee.

cards.text: Twenty towns! So Hiram goes out from Tyre to inspect them himself.

cards.question: Hiram is pleased with the twenty towns Solomon gave him.

cards.text: Hiram is NOT pleased. “What are these towns you have given me, my brother?” he asks.
He calls them the Land of Cabul, a name they still had when this was written. That's a man who opened the cookie box and found crumbs.
Oh, and Hiram had sent the king 120 talents of gold. Back when I lived in a junk drawer, the richest thing in there was an expired coupon.

Next comes the account of the forced labor behind Solomon's building: the LORD's house, his palace, the wall of Jerusalem, towns like Hazor, Megiddo and Gezer, and store cities for his chariots and horses. About Gezer: Pharaoh king of Egypt had captured it, set it on fire and killed the Canaanites living there. Then he gave it as a dowry to his daughter, Solomon's wife.

cards.question: All that building takes forced labor. Who does Solomon conscript to do it?

answers.text: The non-Israelites still in the land

cards.text: These are the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites and Jebusites left in the land, the ones the Israelites were unable to devote to destruction. They were still forced laborers when this was written.

cards.question: Solomon doesn't consign a single Israelite to slavery. Why not?

answers.text: They are his men of war and commanders
They pay Solomon a yearly tax
They are needed to farm the land

cards.question: On Solomon's projects, Israelites serve as the chief officers over the people who do the work.
Solomon built a palace for someone. As soon as she comes up from the City of David to it, he builds the supporting terraces. Who is she?
Solomon offers burnt offerings and peace offerings on the altar he built for the LORD ___ times a year.
King Solomon assembles a fleet of ships at Ezion-geber, near Eloth in Edom, on the shore of the Red Sea. Who sends servants, sailors who know the sea, to serve in the fleet?
Hiram's sailors and Solomon's servants sail to ___ and bring back gold.

cards.text: They bring back 420 talents of gold from Ophir and deliver it to Solomon.
